image_description: A close-up, low-angle view of a modern staircase featuring a metal bannister system. The handrail is a sleek, tubular metal bar running diagonally upwards. It is supported by thin vertical metal balusters and a secondary horizontal railing structure. To the left, there is a darker wooden structural element or secondary railing. The steps appear to be made of light-colored stone or concrete with visible treads.
